text:
luca: FYI rolling kube upgrade to 1.30 started in eu-west-1. Hit an autoscaler regression: GPU nodepools not being considered for scale-up, pods Pending due to GPU scheduling.
priya: logs? what is the autoscaler error?
luca: paste from cluster-autoscaler: ```W0412 10:15:22.123 cluster_autoscaler.go:402] failed to parse node group: decoding NodeGroupSpec: json: unknown field "nodeGroupRef"```
devon: ugh that matches the k8s API rename we saw in the beta release notes — some providers swapped nodeGroupRef -> nodePoolRef in 1.30. autoscaler codepath expects the old key.
sam: can we patch the autoscaler mapping at runtime? urgent because a few jobs are stuck in ci with GPU requests.
priya: quick mitigation: add a mutating webhook to normalize incoming NodeGroup CRD payloads, or patch the CA deployment to use a compatibility image.
luca: I spun a debug pod and dumped the CRD from control plane: ```kubectl get nodegroups.machine.example.com -o yaml gpu-pool -n infra \napiVersion: infra.example.com/v1beta1\nkind: NodeGroup\nspec:\n  nodePoolRef: gpupool-eu-west-1\n  template: {}\n```
priya: yep nodePoolRef present, autoscaler expects nodeGroupRef. We'll do a small admission webhook shim to set nodeGroupRef if missing.
sam: I opened a minimal patch that adds a compatibility layer in the cluster-autoscaler image: https://git.internal/rw/autoscaler/compare/compat-1-30 
sam: runbook (hotfix):
1) kubectl -n kube-system set image deploy/cluster-autoscaler cluster-autoscaler=registry.internal/rw/cluster-autoscaler:compat-1-30
2) roll back if errors: kubectl -n kube-system rollout undo deploy/cluster-autoscaler
3) watch events: kubectl -n infra get nodegroups -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}'

priya: applied compat image to eu-west-1 cluster. Monitoring.
mia: after deploy, autoscaler logs show scaling decisions again: ```I0412 10:23:08  cluster_autoscaler.go:558] Scale-up: adding 2 nodes to gpupool-eu-west-1 (reason: pending pods with nvidia.com/gpu).``` :tada:
luca: confirmed pods started mounting GPUs, CI jobs progressing.
devon: next steps: upstream PR to autoscaler to accept both `nodeGroupRef` and `nodePoolRef` fields and add e2e against kube-1.30 CRD variations.
sam: filing jira infra-12345 for follow-up and cost check (we temporarily increased capacity).
ops-bot: Deploy event: cluster-autoscaler compat-1-30 image rolled in eu-west-1 by sam at 2026-04-12T10:20:00Z
priya: also reminded cloud team to check instance quotas in eu-west-1 — autoscaler requested 12 GPUs during warmup, cost spike note.
luca: thanks all. Leaving the compat image for 48h while upstream PR merges and we cut a proper release.

(reactions: :thumbsup: from devon, :eyes: from mia)
